bars.EXACT: official identifier match (license, NMLS, NPN, NAIC, CRD, CMS CCN, state facility ID, USDOT, CAL-T, FACID, PWCR, source-native stable ID)
bars.HIGH_CONFIDENCE: exact legal name + exact official business address, or an approved deterministic crosswalk
bars.REVIEW_REQUIRED: name + city; DBA ambiguity; common-name conflict; person/company ambiguity
bars.UNSAFE: name alone; phone alone; search-engine matching

rules: Never auto-attach adverse evidence from unsafe identity.
Profile-level negative/regulatory evidence requires the higher identity bar.
Aggregate/source-level evidence can be published with incomplete identity.
